sentences.text:
This application coming on for admission this day, the   following:
 ORDER 1.

This is an application filed under Section 439 of Cr.P.C. on behalf of applicant, who is in jail since 21.4.2023 in connection with Crime No. 121/2023, registered at Police Station Kotwali District Anuppur for the offence punishable under Sections 376 (1), 376(2)(N) of the IPC and Sections 3, 4,
51, 6 of the POCSO Act.
2 . Learned counsel appearing for the applicant submitted that applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the case.

Applicant was about to get married to prosecutrix and they were Ajay Choudhary vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 18 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/120278295/

sentences.text: Both of them established physical relationship with consent.
As applicant was not married to prosecutrix, she has lodged false complaint against him.

In these circumstances,
applicant may be enlarged on bail.
3 . Learned counsel appearing for the State has opposed the bail application.

4. Heard learned counsel for the parties and perused the statement recorded under Section 164 of the Cr.P.C.
5.
Prosecutrix is aged about 17 1/2 years at the time of incident.
Applicant and prosecutrix have established physical relationship with each other.
When applicant was not married to prosecutrix, she has lodged false complaint against him.
6. Considering the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by the applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that the applicant shall be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court.

8. In addition to aforesaid condition, the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of Cr.P.C.
Certified copy as per rules (VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE DUBEY/-
